education.en: Education is the most effective way to reduce poverty in the long term.
education.zh: 从长远看,教育是减少贫困最有效的方法。

academic.en: Academic success does not always lead to a satisfying career.
academic.zh: 学术上的成功并不总能带来令人满意的职业。

primary-school.en: Foreign languages should be taught from the first year of primary school.
primary-school.zh: 外语应该从小学一年级开始教。

secondary-school.en: Many secondary school students feel under pressure to get high grades.
secondary-school.zh: 许多中学生感到要取得高分的压力。

tertiary-education.en: Tertiary education should be free for students from poor families.
tertiary-education.zh: 贫困家庭的学生应该能免费接受高等教育。

higher-education.en: More young people than ever now have access to higher education.
higher-education.zh: 现在能接受高等教育的年轻人比以往任何时候都多。

vocational.en: Vocational courses can prepare young people well for skilled jobs.
vocational.zh: 职业课程能帮助年轻人为技术工作做好准备。

vocational-training.en: Vocational training is often more useful than a university degree for some jobs.
vocational-training.zh: 对某些工作来说,职业培训往往比大学学位更有用。

kindergarten.en: Children who attend kindergarten often settle more easily into primary school.
kindergarten.zh: 上过幼儿园的孩子往往更容易适应小学。

preschool.en: Preschool education helps young children to develop social and language skills.
preschool.zh: 学龄前教育帮助幼儿发展社交和语言能力。

pupil.en: Each pupil should have the chance to take part in sports at school.
pupil.zh: 每个学生都应该有机会在学校参加体育活动。

graduate.en: Many graduates find it difficult to get a job in their chosen field.
graduate.zh: 许多毕业生很难在自己选择的领域找到工作。

graduate.en: Students who graduate with heavy debts may delay buying their own homes.
graduate.zh: 背负沉重债务毕业的学生可能推迟买房。

dropout.en: A school dropout is much more likely to face unemployment later in life.
dropout.zh: 辍学者日后面临失业的可能性要大得多。

compulsory-education.en: Compulsory education should continue until the age of eighteen.
compulsory-education.zh: 义务教育应该延续到十八岁。

state-school.en: Many parents believe that a state school can offer an equally good education.
state-school.zh: 许多家长认为,公立学校同样能提供良好的教育。

private-school.en: Families who choose a private school often pay very high fees.
private-school.zh: 选择私立学校的家庭往往要支付很高的费用。

boarding-school.en: Some children find it hard to live away from home at boarding school.
boarding-school.zh: 有些孩子觉得在寄宿学校离家生活很难。

single-sex-school.en: Some people argue that girls do better in a single-sex school.
single-sex-school.zh: 有些人认为女孩在单性别学校表现更好。

co-educational.en: Co-educational schools help boys and girls to learn how to work together.
co-educational.zh: 男女同校有助于男孩和女孩学会合作。

homeschooling.en: Homeschooling allows parents to choose what and how their children learn.
homeschooling.zh: 在家教育让父母能选择孩子学什么和怎么学。

distance-learning.en: Distance learning allows people in remote areas to study for a degree.
distance-learning.zh: 远程教育让偏远地区的人也能攻读学位。

e-learning.en: E-learning offers flexibility, but some students miss direct contact with teachers.
e-learning.zh: 在线学习提供了灵活性,但有些学生怀念与老师的直接接触。

lifelong-learning.en: Lifelong learning has become essential because skills change so quickly.
lifelong-learning.zh: 由于技能变化太快,终身学习已变得至关重要。

pedagogy.en: Good pedagogy matters more than expensive equipment in the classroom.
pedagogy.zh: 在课堂上,好的教学法比昂贵的设备更重要。

instruct.en: Teachers should instruct children in how to use the internet safely.
instruct.zh: 老师应该教导孩子如何安全地使用互联网。

instruction.en: Students receive instruction in both English and their native language.
instruction.zh: 学生接受英语和母语两种语言的教学。

rote-learning.en: Rote learning may help students pass exams but does not develop understanding.
rote-learning.zh: 死记硬背也许能帮学生通过考试,但不能增进理解。

memorise.en: Students should do more than simply memorise facts for an exam.
memorise.zh: 学生不应该只是为了考试而记住事实。

spoon-feeding.en: Spoon-feeding students leaves them unable to solve problems by themselves.
spoon-feeding.zh: 填鸭式教学使学生无法独立解决问题。

critical-thinking.en: Schools should place more emphasis on developing critical thinking.
critical-thinking.zh: 学校应该更加重视培养批判性思维。

problem-solving.en: Group projects are an excellent way of teaching problem-solving skills.
problem-solving.zh: 小组项目是培养解决问题能力的极好方法。

analytical.en: Studying mathematics helps children to develop strong analytical skills.
analytical.zh: 学习数学有助于孩子培养强大的分析能力。

creative.en: Art and music lessons encourage children to be more creative.
creative.zh: 美术和音乐课鼓励孩子更有创造力。

all-round.en: Schools should aim to provide an all-round education for every child.
all-round.zh: 学校应该致力于为每个孩子提供全面的教育。

well-rounded.en: Sports and the arts help students to become well-rounded adults.
well-rounded.zh: 体育和艺术帮助学生成长为全面发展的成年人。

extracurricular.en: Extracurricular clubs give students a chance to develop new interests.
extracurricular.zh: 课外社团让学生有机会培养新的兴趣。

academic-performance.en: Some studies suggest that regular exercise can improve academic performance.
academic-performance.zh: 一些研究表明,经常锻炼可以提高学业表现。

achievement.en: Family income has a strong influence on a child's achievement at school.
achievement.zh: 家庭收入对孩子在学校的成就有很大影响。

intellectual.en: Puzzles and games can support the intellectual development of young children.
intellectual.zh: 拼图和游戏可以促进幼儿的智力发展。

intellectual.en: Intellectuals have often played an important part in political change.
intellectual.zh: 知识分子常常在政治变革中发挥重要作用。

knowledge.en: Practical skills are often as valuable as knowledge gained from books.
knowledge.zh: 实践技能往往和书本知识一样宝贵。

competence.en: Students should reach a basic level of competence in computer skills.
competence.zh: 学生的计算机能力应该达到基本水平。

proficiency.en: A high level of proficiency in English can open many doors.
proficiency.zh: 高水平的英语熟练度能打开许多大门。

aptitude.en: Children with an aptitude for music should be given extra support.
aptitude.zh: 有音乐天资的孩子应该得到额外支持。

talent.en: Schools should help every child to discover their natural talent.
talent.zh: 学校应该帮助每个孩子发现自己的天赋。

gifted.en: Gifted children can become bored if lessons are too easy for them.
gifted.zh: 如果课程太简单,有天赋的孩子可能会感到无聊。

obedient.en: Traditional schools often valued obedient students more than creative ones.
obedient.zh: 传统学校往往更看重顺从的学生,而不是有创造力的学生。

rebellious.en: Teenagers can become rebellious if parents set too many strict rules.
rebellious.zh: 如果父母定下太多严格的规矩,青少年可能变得叛逆。

truant.en: A persistent truant is more likely to become involved in crime.
truant.zh: 长期逃学者更有可能卷入犯罪。

bullying.en: Schools must take strong action against all forms of bullying.
bullying.zh: 学校必须采取有力行动,打击各种形式的欺凌。

class-size.en: Reducing class size allows teachers to give each student more attention.
class-size.zh: 缩小班级规模让老师能给每个学生更多关注。

teacher-student-ratio.en: A low teacher-student ratio can make it hard for pupils to get help.
teacher-student-ratio.zh: 师生比低会使学生很难得到帮助。

educator.en: Every educator knows that children learn in different ways.
educator.zh: 每位教育工作者都知道孩子们的学习方式各不相同。

mentor.en: An experienced mentor can help young workers to develop their careers.
mentor.zh: 经验丰富的导师能帮助年轻员工发展事业。

role-model.en: Teachers can be an important role model for young people.
role-model.zh: 老师可以成为年轻人重要的榜样。

qualified.en: Every school needs enough qualified teachers in science and mathematics.
qualified.zh: 每所学校都需要足够的合格的科学和数学教师。

standardised-test.en: A standardised test cannot measure every skill that students need.
standardised-test.zh: 标准化考试无法衡量学生需要的每一项技能。

exam-oriented.en: An exam-oriented system leaves little time for art, music and sports.
exam-oriented.zh: 应试制度几乎不给美术、音乐和体育留时间。

tuition.en: The cost of university tuition has risen sharply in many countries.
tuition.zh: 在许多国家,大学学费急剧上涨。

student-loan.en: A student loan can take many years to pay back after graduation.
student-loan.zh: 学生贷款可能要在毕业后很多年才能还清。

gap-year.en: A gap year can give young people valuable experience of the wider world.
gap-year.zh: 间隔年能让年轻人获得了解更广阔世界的宝贵经验。

study-abroad.en: Students who study abroad often gain independence and new language skills.
study-abroad.zh: 出国留学的学生常常变得更独立,并掌握新的语言技能。

brain-drain.en: The brain drain has left many poor countries short of doctors.
brain-drain.zh: 人才流失使许多贫穷国家缺少医生。

equal-opportunity.en: Governments should ensure equal opportunity in education for boys and girls.
equal-opportunity.zh: 政府应该确保男孩和女孩在教育上机会均等。

numeracy.en: Basic numeracy is essential for managing money in everyday life.
numeracy.zh: 基本计算能力对日常生活中的理财至关重要。

illiteracy.en: Illiteracy remains a serious barrier to economic progress in some countries.
illiteracy.zh: 文盲仍然是一些国家经济发展的严重障碍。

educational.en: Some television programmes have a clear educational value for young children.
educational.zh: 一些电视节目对幼儿有明显的教育价值。

didactic.en: Young readers often dislike stories that are too didactic.
didactic.zh: 年轻读者常常不喜欢过于说教的故事。

disobedient.en: Disobedient children often need clear rules rather than harsh punishment.
disobedient.zh: 不听话的孩子往往需要明确的规则,而不是严厉的惩罚。

classics.en: Students should still read the classics, even in the age of the internet.
classics.zh: 即使在互联网时代,学生也应该读经典著作。

team-spirit.en: Team sports help children to develop a strong team spirit.
team-spirit.zh: 团队运动帮助孩子培养强烈的团队精神。

extracurricular-activities.en: Extracurricular activities can improve a student's confidence and social skills.
extracurricular-activities.zh: 课外活动可以增强学生的自信心和社交能力。
